title: First Koszul homology regularity implies quasi-regularity
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof first controls coefficients of pure powers using vanishing of first Koszul homology. A faithfully flat polynomial extension and a generic change of basis reduce all homogeneous coefficient relations to that special case, yielding the associated-graded conclusion.
